saw.short: ITV confirms the I'm A Celebrity line-up
saw.headline: ITV confirms the *I’m A Celebrity line-up*
saw.what: ITV has confirmed this year’s I’m A Celebrity line-up, including Wayne Rooney, Chloe Burrows, Ricky Wilson, Joanna Page, Ade Adepitan and YouTuber Sharky. The series starts on Monday 16 November at 9pm on ITV1 and ITVX. TV Zone’s ITV-sourced list also names Leigh Francis as a late entrant.
saw.why: A big-name line-up with a Premier League legend and a YouTuber. Expect weeks of chat.

saw.short: Waitrose's six-minute Christmas ad is out
saw.headline: *Waitrose’s six-minute Christmas ad* is out
saw.what: Waitrose has released “The Perfect Gift 2”, a six-minute sequel to last year’s ad, with Keira Knightley, Joe Wilkinson and Alex Hassell. Waitrose calls it the longest ad made by a UK supermarket, per Metro. Heart reports more than 30,000 Instagram likes in four hours, but doesn’t name the account.
saw.why: A sequel with a cinema-style run time. The reaction is strong, so far.

saw.short: Man Utd are reviewing Michael Carrick's position
saw.headline: Man Utd are *reviewing head coach Michael Carrick’s position*
saw.what: The Press Association understands Manchester United are reviewing head coach Michael Carrick’s position during the international break. Sky Sports says the club will not rush a decision. United are in the relegation zone after the 4-4 draw with Aston Villa, with one league win in 10. Nothing was confirmed when we checked on Wednesday morning.
saw.why: A big club in trouble. Football fans are filling feeds with takes.
saw.source: PA via Irish News, 9 Nov; Sky Sports, 9 Nov

saw.short: Reports say Pattinson and Hoult screen-tested for Bond
saw.headline: Reports say *Pattinson and Hoult* screen-tested for Bond
saw.what: Variety and Deadline report that Robert Pattinson and Nicholas Hoult have screen-tested for James Bond. Deadline says the news is not confirmed and cites insiders. Amazon MGM has confirmed no casting. A separate report that Harry Styles discussed the role is second-hand.
saw.why: Casting rumours are easy engagement. Treat every name as unconfirmed.

saw.short: McKenna Grace recreates Finnick's sugar cube scene
saw.headline: *McKenna Grace* recreates Finnick’s sugar cube scene
saw.what: McKenna Grace, who stars in The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping, recreated Finnick’s sugar cube scene in a costume video. Sam Claflin, who played Finnick, told Entertainment Tonight he commented “girl on” with a fire emoji. The film is in UK cinemas from 20 Nov, per Flicks.
saw.why: A fan-style tribute from the cast is the kind of film content that travels.

platform.short: X adds a clip video option
platform.headline: X adds a *clip video* option for longer videos
platform.what: X says users can now clip videos longer than two minutes, sharing a 5 to 60 second clip that credits and links to the original. The post from X Creators says to tap Repost, then Clip video, on iOS and Android. X hasn’t listed countries.
platform.why: Reaction clips get easier on X. Original creators stay credited.
platform.source: X Creators, 9 Nov; Social Media Today, 10 Nov

platform.headline: Threads rolls out *advanced search*
platform.what: Threads says it’s rolling out advanced search, with filters for date range, community and post type, and an exact-match option. Threads names no countries.
platform.why: Easier to find specific posts. Useful for brand and trend research.

platform.short: Reddit tests Reddit Reviews, US first
platform.headline: Reddit tests *Reddit Reviews*, US first
platform.what: Reddit is testing Reddit Reviews, which uses AI to compile product reviews from community conversations. It starts with US users over the next few weeks, with around 10,000 products to begin with. Some reviews include images, prices and purchase links supplied by brands and retailers.
platform.why: Reddit is turning conversation into shopping advice. Not yet in the UK.
platform.source: Reddit, 10 Nov; Social Media Today, 10 Nov
